readings.meaning: new release or special promo alert

ambiguity: Very similar to standard circle or triangle warning icons, and the starburst outline can look like a gear or settings cog at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: alert, warning, issue, attention required, or expiration

reasoning: The icon shows a 10-pointed starburst or seal badge containing an exclamation mark. It fits tasks centered on alerts, warnings, incident notifications, or expiring certifications/badges, though it is easily confused with standard triangle/circle warning icons or even a gear at small sizes (and shouldn't be misused just to mark an ordinary task as 'urgent').
